description: Links whose href arrives through spread attributes (shadcn-svelte's BreadcrumbLink pattern: a derived bag holding the href prop and the rest props; a constant bag; an explicit href after a spread with an open one), clicked and followed with Enter: fragments naming no element (popstate, hashchange as a task), a value switched between two fragments, a link without an href doing nothing, and the document top below the fold after a wheel scroll, reached with Tab (# and #top: the document element scrolled into view, focus left on the link, hashchange only where the URL changed; Enter on the focused link scrolled out of view again following it again)
